key: ["After the Mauryas, no one holds the whole. The Satavahanas rule the Deccan. Greeks, Shakas and then Kushans come through the north-west. In the Tamil country reign the Chera, the Chola and the Pandya. From about 320 CE the Guptas build the largest state of their time on the Ganga plain. These are the centuries of Aryabhata, of Nalanda, of the painted caves at Ajanta. By the seventh century Harsha rules from Kannauj, and in the south the Chalukyas and the Pallavas go to war.", "sarvam:varun_en_suspense@en-IN", "+6%", "+0Hz", null, 1.0, 0.0, "v3"]
